name: Send to Marvin
desc: Sends the current page, a lasso selection, or selected document text to Claude (Anthropic API) to extract to-dos, then adds them to your Amazing Marvin inbox. Note images and text are sent to api.anthropic.com; tasks are sent to serv.amazingmarvin.com. Requires API keys in MyStyle/SnMarvin/config.json.
author: ddpedersen
